messages.text:
The captured page is a different generated route tree than the code I just wrote: it has `/admin` links and no gallery heading from our storefront.

Start’s route generator has overwritten my hand-written `routeTree.gen.ts` with its own names, and the e2e selectors were still pointed at the newer component wording.

I’m aligning the tests with the actual accessible app surface and fixing the route links that should point to `/creator`.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'rg "POWERPROMPT Gallery home|/admin|Prompt gallery|Reveal search" src -n'
commands.preview: rg "POWERPROMPT Gallery home|/admin|Prompt gallery|Reveal search" src -n
